classification: security-critical: browser sandbox and shared egress

tests.command: .venv/bin/ruff check apps services database/migrations deploy/crawler-network scripts tests
.venv/bin/ruff format --check apps services database/migrations deploy/crawler-network scripts tests

browser_lab.image_scope: invocation-owned Chromium headless-shell image, removed after qualification; not a production release
browser_lab.provider_behavior: Synthetic fixtures behind shared egress; the pinned HTTP fetcher runs on an isolated public-shaped lab network. Jev protocol responses use a shared-egress double, not live TypeSafe.
browser_lab.containers_and_networks: Session-owned resources destroyed after each context; no browser-session containers remained after the run.
browser_lab.build_cache_and_image: Invocation-private BuildKit builder/cache and exported image removed; no shared prune or unrelated container stop.
browser_lab.qualified_sandbox: OCI non-root, read-only, no mounts or credentials, dropped capabilities, no-new-privileges and isolated proxy-only network; separate Chromium user-namespace sandbox not claimed
negative_coverage: No default route or direct public, loopback or metadata connection from inside the container; only the proxy endpoint is reachable.
Private/loopback/metadata resolution, private redirect, non-admitted origins, SERP/assistant origin families, robots denial, rate limits, non-read verbs, credentials, size and time limits.
Typing, button clicks, submission, downloads, uploads, arbitrary evaluation and popups rejected inside the worker; injected form/POST/dialog/WebSocket/service-worker page stays inert.
Out-of-list and low-confidence Jev choices stop; a delayed credential wait expires at the session deadline, records a labelled fallback and destroys containers.
Step/time/byte exhaustion, state outage, sealed-fragment mismatch, immutable forced-RLS evidence, function-only runtime access and encrypted screenshot artifacts.

local_failure_accounting: Early browser fixtures used a reserved pytest parameter and an invalid below-minimum politeness policy. Corrected the fixtures and retained the shared minimum; bounded deferral waits do not weaken admission.
Qualification caught terminal byte accounting losing screenshot usage. The ledger is now monotonic through terminal evidence; real Docker rendering/screenshot and byte-exhaustion cases pass.
Review added nonblocking idle input expiry and the host-side Jev deadline with real-container expiry/teardown tests. Final browser qualification passed 35/0.

The first full PostgreSQL run passed 839/840 and failed only its inherited exact table-count assertion: migration 0072 adds three tables, making 106 rather than 103. Updated the exact count while preserving the predicate requiring every table to be migrator-owned with enabled and forced RLS. The final repeat passed 840/0.

commit_range_secret_scan.execution: Run after commit and before branch push; result belongs in the PR qualification account.
